description: Manage negative keywords in Google Ads across campaign, ad-group, shared negative list (create, add/remove terms, attach/detach campaigns), and account levels, with full post-change readback.

account_level.description: Apply negative keywords at the Google Ads account (customer) level

ad_group_id.description: Ad group ID for AD_GROUP level negatives

all_enabled.description: Apply to all enabled Search/Display campaigns

attach_campaign_ids.description: Campaign IDs to attach the shared negative list to

campaign_ids.description: Multiple Campaign IDs to apply negatives to

create_shared_set.description: Create the shared negative keyword list if it does not already exist

customer_id.description: Optional Google Ads customer ID (alias of account_id)

detach_campaign_ids.description: Campaign IDs to detach the shared negative list from

readback_only.description: Read back all negative keywords (including shared-list attachments and account-level negatives) without mutating

remove_criterion_ids.description: Negative keyword criterion IDs to remove

shared_set_id.description: Shared negative keyword list ID (SharedSet ID)

shared_set_name.description: Shared negative keyword list name (to create or look up by name)

name: add_negative_keywords
